name: Base36alphabetshift

description_json.name: Base36AlphabetShift
description_json.idea: A simple, highly deterministic substitution cipher that shifts alphanumeric characters (a-z, 0-9) forward by 5 positions in a combined 36-character alphabet sequence: 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'. Case is preserved for letters, and non-alphanumeric characters (spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Define the sequence: 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' (length 36).
2. For each character in the plaintext:
   a. If it is a lowercase letter or digit, find its index in the sequence, add 5, take modulo 36, and replace with the character at that new index.
   b. If it is an uppercase letter, convert to lowercase, find its index, add 5, take modulo 36, convert the resulting character to uppercase (if it is a letter), and replace.
   c. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. Define the sequence: 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' (length 36).
2. For each character in the ciphertext:
   a. If it is a lowercase letter or digit, find its index in the sequence, subtract 5, take modulo 36, and replace with the character at that new index.
   b. If it is an uppercase letter, convert to lowercase, find its index, subtract 5, take modulo 36, convert the resulting character to uppercase (if it is a letter), and replace.
   c. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it unchanged.
